name: L4
notes: NVIDIA's L4 datasheet gives only the sparse (with-sparsity) figures for TF32/BF16/FP16/FP8/INT8 Tensor Core, with an explicit footnote: '*Shown with sparsity. Specifications 1/2 lower without sparsity.' -- unlike most other records in this dataset where dense figures are left null when not independently published, here the dense values recorded (half of sparse) are DERIVED per NVIDIA's own explicit halving rule stated in that footnote, not independently sourced. cuda_cores/tensor_cores/sm_count not found: NVIDIA's L4 datasheet and product page state Tensor Core generation (4th) and RT Core generation (3rd) by name only, with no numeric core counts given anywhere. gpu_chip of AD104 and process_node_nm of 4 (TSMC 4N) ARE directly NVIDIA-sourced, contrary to an earlier belief in this dataset that no NVIDIA doc names L4's die -- NVIDIA's own 'Ada GPU Architecture' whitepaper (a separate document from the L4 product datasheet/page) explicitly tabulates 'GPU Code Name: AD104' for L4 (Appendix D, Table 5) and states Ada-generation GPUs are fabricated on 'TSMC's 4N manufacturing process' generation-wide. Note some third-party sources (TechPowerUp) label this node numerically as '5 nm' while still tagging it '4N FinFET' -- TSMC's '4N' is a customized 5nm-class node, not a true linear 4nm process; 4 is recorded here as the marketing-name-derived integer, consistent with how H100/H200/B200/B300's TSMC 4N/4NP process is recorded elsewhere in this dataset. release_date of 2023-03-21 is NVIDIA's GTC Spring 2023 announcement. No NVLink (PCIe-only card, absent from datasheet). multi_instance_max null: L4 does not appear in NVIDIA's official MIG-supported-GPU list.

_sources.multi_instance_max: https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/tesla/mig-user-guide/supported-gpus.html (MIG-supported GPU list does not include L4)
_sources.process_node_nm: https://images.nvidia.com/aem-dam/Solutions/Data-Center/l4/nvidia-ada-gpu-architecture-whitepaper-V2.02.pdf ('Ada GPUs are fabricated on TSMC's 4N manufacturing process', generation-wide statement, not an AD104-specific sentence)
